text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling and fewer evenings spent on CRM updates.

**2. Notes improved, not just sped up.** Next steps and objections were captured consistently, which made handoffs to solutions engineers far smoother.

**3. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated at first. Asking consent upfront, and explaining why, turned most skeptics into non-issues.

**4. Accuracy needs a human.** Product names and jargon were occasionally garbled. A quick two-minute review caught nearly everything.

**5. Adoption followed managers.** Teams whose leaders used the summaries in coaching stuck with it. Others faded.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It protected the time we use for it.

What's your team seeing?
